step1_analysis.description: A clocked differential comparator (StrongARM latch) used for high-speed quantization in a flash ADC. It features a clocked tail current source, a differential input pair, a cross-coupled inverter latch, precharge/equalization PMOS transistors, and output buffers.

input: IN_MINUS (Missing in extraction, patched in testbench)
ground: N3 (Missing ground connection, patched in testbench)

paper_reference.title: A 40-GHz-Bandwidth, 4-Bit, Time-Interleaved A/D Converter Using Photoconductive Sampling

clk_to_q_delay.description: Delay from the rising edge of the clock to the output crossing 50% of VDD.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the discharge rate of the internal nodes and the cross-coupled pair positive feedback time constant.
sky130_expected.reasoning: In 130nm CMOS at 1.8V, a StrongARM latch typically resolves in 50-200ps depending on the input differential voltage.

power_consumption.description: Average power consumption of the latch during continuous clocking.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dynamic power P = C * V^2 * f. With ~50fF total switching capacitance at 160MHz and 1.8V, P ~ 50f * 3.24 * 160M = 26uW. Short circuit current adds to this.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 70mW reported in the paper is for the entire 4-bit interleaved ADC. A single latch at 160MHz consumes very little power, typically in the tens of microwatts.

output_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing of the output buffers.

sky130_expected.calculation: Output buffers are standard CMOS inverters tied to VDD and GND.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The inverters should provide full rail-to-rail swing at 1.8V supply.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure Clock-to-Q delay, average power consumption, and output voltage swing of the StrongARM latch. Note: The extracted netlist contains two structural errors (XM4 has gate shorted to source, and N3 is floating). These are patched directly in the testbench using external components to restore normal operation.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for StrongARM Latch
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/libs.tech/ngspice/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N0 LABEL_NET_0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N5 LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 LABEL_NET_2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 N1 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 LABEL_NET_3 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 N5 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N5 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N7 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N6 N0 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N5 N0 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N7 N5 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N6 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N0 LABEL_NET_4 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}

* Fixes for broken netlist extraction
* XM4 was extracted with Gate shorted to Source. We add the correct differential input transistor.
XM4_fix N4 IN_MINUS N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
* N3 is the source of the output inverters but was left floating. Tie to GND.
VN3 N3 0 0

* Power supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Clock signal (160 MHz as per paper, T = 6.25ns)
VCLK CLK 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 50p 50p 3n 6.25n)
R0 LABEL_NET_0 CLK 1m
R1 LABEL_NET_1 CLK 1m
R2 LABEL_NET_2 CLK 1m
R4 LABEL_NET_4 CLK 1m

* Input signals (Differential, common mode 0.9V, 100mV differential)
VIN_P LABEL_NET_3 0 0.95
VIN_N IN_MINUS 0 0.85

* Load capacitance
C1 N6 0 10f
C2 N7 0 10f

.control
  tran 10p 20n
  
  * Measure Clock-to-Q delay on the second rising edge (t=6.25ns)
  meas tran delay_clk_q trig v(CLK) val=0.9 rise=2 targ v(N6) val=0.9 rise=2
  
  * Measure average power consumption over one full clock cycle
  meas tran pwr_avg avg i(VVDD) from=6.25n to=12.5n
  let power_mw = -pwr_avg * 1.8 * 1000
  print power_mw
  
  * Measure output voltage swing
  meas tran vout_max max v(N6) from=6.25n to=12.5n
  meas tran vout_min min v(N6) from=6.25n to=12.5n
  let v_swing = vout_max - vout_min
  print v_swing
  
  quit
.endc
